'''Sonar''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. It could be installed into a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] chassis.<ref name="RPG" /> The [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] of a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] was equipped with sonar transceivers.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
